question: Cross-Encoder Reranker（如bge-reranker-v2-m3）在Top-5候选集中进行精排，可将Recall@5从~0.75提升至~0.85-0.90，单查询推理延迟增加约150-300ms（在M1 Max本地运行）

sources.title: Reranker — BGE documentation
sources.snippet: Reranker, or Cross-Encoder, is a model that refines the ranking of candidate pairs (e.g., query-document pairs) by jointly encoding and scoring them. Typically, we use embedder as a Bi-Encoder.

sources.title: BGE-Reranker-v2-m3技术背景详解：Cross-Encoder原理剖析-CSDN博客
sources.snippet: 文章浏览阅读379次，点赞3次，收藏8次。本文深入剖析BGE-Reranker-v2-m3重排序模型的技术原理，重点讲解其基于Cross-Encoder架构如何实现查询与文档的深层语义交互。相比Bi-Encoder，该模型通过联合编码提升语义匹配精度，有效缓解RAG系统中的'搜不准'问题，并在多语言、长文本场景下展现良好性能。

sources.title: BGE-Reranker — BGE documentation
sources.snippet: BGE-Reranker # Different from embedding model, reranker, or cross-encoder uses question and document as input and directly output similarity instead of embedding. To balance the accuracy and time cost, cross-encoder is widely used to re-rank top-k documents retrieved by other simple models.
